FOLIO NO. 04 — FEATURED
The Black Barn returns to the spring calendar.

After a quiet winter — new flooring, a re-pointed chimney, and a new tinsmith — the house returns to the open list this week. We've kept the late-spring window quiet, by design.

FOLIO NO. 05 — IN PLANNING
Casa Encinal, between fog and fire.

Of all the houses in the portfolio, Casa Encinal is the one we most often photograph at four in the afternoon. The light, then, lifts the long shadows from the eaves and warms the limestone to a tone of weak honey.
